# Exact GO:0006915 human, mouse, and zebrafish snapshot

Human and mouse were fetched from the QuickGO annotation API on 2026-09-30 with
[`fetch_go0006915.py`](fetch_go0006915.py), using `goId=GO:0006915`,
`goUsage=exact`, and `taxonId` set to either human `9606` or mouse `10090`.
Zebrafish was added on 2026-10-05 with `taxonId` set to `7955`.
Descendant annotations were deliberately excluded so this is only the broad
top-level `apoptotic process` row set.

To refresh the standing human and mouse snapshot from the repository root:

```sh
uv run projects/APOPTOSIS/fetch_go0006915.py
```

To refresh the zebrafish extension:

```sh
uv run projects/APOPTOSIS/fetch_go0006915.py --taxon zebrafish
```

## Snapshot size

| Taxon | Exact GO:0006915 rows | Symbols |
|---|---:|---:|
| human | 825 | 345 |
| mouse | 557 | 238 |
| zebrafish | 253 | 82 |

Rows are not unique biological assertions. The human `TP53` block alone has
103 rows because broad InterPro IEA rows are repeated over many UniProt
accessions and isoforms; the symbol rollups are therefore a better worklist
view than the raw rows.

| Taxon | IEA | IDA | IMP | IGI | IPI | IBA | ISO | ISS | TAS | NAS | RCA | ISA |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| human | 530 | 44 | 37 | 4 | 2 | 28 | 0 | 7 | 106 | 67 | 0 | 0 |
| mouse | 256 | 21 | 99 | 10 | 0 | 26 | 97 | 28 | 4 | 1 | 14 | 1 |
| zebrafish | 204 | 3 | 19 | 0 | 0 | 24 | 0 | 3 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

Human exact rows are dominated by electronic sources, chiefly InterPro and
UniProt IEA imports. Mouse has a larger experimental fraction because MGI
contributes many IMP rows from survival/death-readout genetics; those are the
rows most likely to need an over-annotation check before accepting a generic
`GO:0006915` assertion.

## Zebrafish InterPro2GO rows

The exact zebrafish slice is mostly not manual ZFIN curation. InterPro contributes
169 of the 253 exact `GO:0006915` rows, and six high-count InterPro2GO mappings
from the largest-symbol worklist account for 127 rows on their own:

| InterPro signature | Main zebrafish symbols | Exact rows |
|---|---|---:|
| `IPR002117`, p53 family | `tp63`, `tp53`, `tp73` | 60 |
| `IPR037847`, GRAMD4 family | `gramd4b`, `gramd4a` | 24 |
| `IPR022103`, BIRC6 | `birc6` | 22 |
| `IPR028319`, PPP1R13B family | `ppp1r13bb` | 9 |
| `IPR028754`, PAK5 family | `pak5` | 6 |
| `IPR018868`, BAD family | `badb`, `bada` | 6 |

These are likely InterPro2GO mapping issues, so the highest-yield fix is upstream
signature review rather than one zebrafish gene at a time. `IPR028754`, which
maps the PAK5 kinase subfamily straight to exact apoptosis, and `IPR002117`,
which maps the whole p53/p63/p73 family to exact apoptosis, are especially strong
candidates to challenge.

## ZFIN experimental row triage

The ZFIN-authored exact `GO:0006915` slice is small: 21 rows, all without
annotation extensions, collapse to seven `(symbol, reference)` packages.
The first-pass curation estimate is metadata-based: it uses GOA evidence
metadata, `with_from` reagents, gene identity, and cached or abstract-level PMID
checks rather than full-text review of all seven papers. Only
`timm50`/PMID:15044455 has a cached publication record in this checkout.

| Bucket | ZFIN exact rows | Evidence packages | Symbols and references |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Likely over-annotated from a cell-death, stress, or top-level IDA readout | 7 | 3 | `hpdl`/PMID:40719007, `dmrt2a`/PMID:10021344, `rpl11`/PMID:19129914 |
| Mechanistically supported but parked too high | 14 | 4 | `tp53`/PMID:21209837, `casp3a`/PMID:18515717, `timm50`/PMID:15044455, `ptmab`/PMID:24032683 |

This is a row count, not a unique-biology count: the `tp53` package alone
contributes eight UniProt rows for the same ZFIN genotype or morpholino evidence,
and `casp3a`, `hpdl`, `dmrt2a`, and `timm50` are also repeated over accessions.

The seven likely over-annotation rows split into two evidence shapes. `hpdl` and
`rpl11` are IMP packages where perturbing a mitochondrial
4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase-like protein or a ribosomal protein changes
a downstream TUNEL, acridine-orange, caspase, or generic cell-death signal; the
first `rpl11` row even shares `ZFIN:ZDB-MRPHLNO-070126-7` with the `tp53` package,
consistent with p53-dependent ribosomal-stress apoptosis. The `dmrt2a` rows are
different because they are IDA rows with no `with_from` reagent, but a direct
top-level BP assertion on a DM-domain transcription factor is still broad enough
to need ZFIN review before a DANRE review accepts exact `apoptotic process`.

The 14 likely pushdown rows are qualitatively different. `casp3a` should move
toward execution-phase apoptosis, `tp53` toward p53-mediated apoptotic signaling
or its regulation, and `timm50` toward the intrinsic branch, release of cytochrome
c from mitochondria, or negative regulation of cytochrome c release. The
single-row `ptmab` package is plausibly apoptosome/caspase-3 regulation, but it
needs full-text checking before assigning a directional regulation term.

## Already reviewed APOPTOSIS targets

The current Priority 1 human review set still covers 132 exact top-level rows:
`FAS` 18, `CASP8` 14, `DIABLO` 14, `BCL2L1` 11, `DFFB` 10, `APAF1` 8,
`CASP9` 8, `DFFA` 6, `CASP3` 5, `FASLG` 5, `BAX` 4, `BCL2` 4, `CASP7` 4,
`CASP6` 3, `PMAIP1` 3, `AIFM1` 2, `BAK1` 2, `BCL2L11` 2, `CASP10` 2,
`BBC3` 1, `CFLAR` 1, `FADD` 1, `TNFRSF10A` 1, `TNFRSF10B` 1, `TNFRSF1A` 1,
and `TNFSF10` 1.

The mouse over-annotation slice covered three symbols with exact top-level rows:
`Bcl2` 9, `Casp3` 9, and `Tnfrsf1a` 1. The broader mouse rollup points to
`Casp9`, `Bad`, `Dap3`, `Ripk1`, `Casp8`, `Col6a1`, `Diablo`, and `Bcl2l1` as
the next reviewed-gene comparators if this project continues the mouse branch.
